history.body: Hi, we’re comparing condos around Seberang Jaya for our own stay, and Pearl Residences seems a little expensive from what I’ve seen. Could you help me understand what the price includes and how it compares on overall value?

I understand—headline prices can be hard to compare fairly. Pearl Residences Phase 1 Type A is 900 sq ft, with 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and a balcony. The pricing reference I have shows base-price examples around RM328k–RM358k, varying by floor and facing; that isn’t a confirmed total for a specific unit. The SPA pricing structure can include the unit base price and applicable car-park or upgrade/accessory components. The materials also list an extra motorcycle bay at RM5k or extra utility at RM8k where applicable, and an upgrading package worth RM10k. These aren’t automatically applicable to every unit, and any rebate is a separate, category-specific item that needs current confirmation.

For an own-stay comparison, it’s worth lining up the total price against a similar 900 sq ft, 3-bedroom unit and checking the car-park allocation and any package items—not just the advertised starting price. If you share the competing quote or its unit size and parking, I can help compare like for like.

That’s useful context, especially comparing the same size and checking the parking and package. I don’t have a formal quote from another condo yet, just lower advertised prices I’ve noticed. Could you confirm the current total for a Type A with one car park? If the full amount is within reach, the layout may be worth looking at more closely.

I can’t confirm the current total yet—the unit-level price for a Type A with one car park and any applicable package items is still being verified, so I don’t want to give you a misleading figure. On the layout, the open-plan living, dining and kitchen arrangement and lack of a long internal corridor are intended to make the 900 sq ft more usable. If it would help you assess the layout while you consider the price, we can look at arranging an optional viewing; nothing is booked.
